# 聖騎士級突擊穿梭機
[color=#a4885c]船隻尺寸：[/color] 小型
[color=#a4885c]艦隊穿梭機：[/color] 否
[color=#a4885c]建議船員人數：[/color] 1-2 人
[color=#a4885c]動力生成類型：[/color] APU
[color=#a4885c]遠征任務：[/color] 否
[color=#a4885c]敵我識別（IFF）控制台：[/color] 是
[color=#a4885c]限制：[/color] 副駕駛
「一款專為太空戰鬥設計的小型安全突擊艇，配備一具 EXP-2100g 固定式榴彈發射器。」
# Ship Functions
- 飛船前方有兩個按鈕：黃黑相間邊框的按鈕用來控制位於前方的防禦簾幕，而紅黑相間邊框的按鈕則用來控制安裝在飛船上的榴彈發射器。
- 除了按鈕之外，榴彈發射器還配備了一個與之連結的遙控裝置，讓您能在追擊過程中迅速發射。
# 關於運作 NSF Paladin 穿梭機的提示 - Paladin 的穿梭機輔助動力單元 (APU) 最高可支援 [color=#a4885c]12 [bold]kW[/bold][/color]。 It is not recommended to go above this due to the small interior space. For more general information on the power grid and other life support systems, refer to the [textlink="Power" link="Power"] guidebook article and the [textlink="Preflight Checklist" link="PreflightChecklist"/]. - For the basics of [bold]shuttle piloting[/bold], refer to [textlink="Piloting" link="Piloting"] and [textlink="Sector Topology" link="SectorTopology"/]. - For the basics of [bold]cargo hauling[/bold], refer to [textlink="Cargo Hauling" link="CargoHauling"]. - For the basics of [bold]expedition diving[/bold], refer to [textlink="Expeditions" link="Expeditions"]. - As a Captain of a Nanotrasen vessel, you have the authority to hire, fire, demote, or promote crew members at will, refer to [textlink="Hiring" link="Hiring"] for more information.
